generationBoundary: This record owns retained built-in ImageGen materials, icons, ornaments, background, and illustrations. Six action surfaces and eight high-exposure structural surfaces now enter export as individual hash-locked ImageGen masters; no generated component sheet remains in the active path. Explicitly supplied or user-approved reference visual parameters are P0 authority, while generic visual guidance fills only unspecified parameters. Export crops transparent content and applies alpha-safe scaling. The action-green RGB plate uses its separately hash-locked approved geometry alpha; the line-free nursery and metric RGB plates each use one deterministic connected-neutral-background cleanup derived from their own pixels so legacy or foreign geometry cannot expose hidden gray/orange edge RGB. A master cannot be shared across incompatible edge/anatomy contracts. Every transparent ImageGen nine-slice clears low-alpha ringing after source and runtime resize and stores zero RGB under zero alpha. It never paints or recolors visible generated material pixels, and contrast failures are corrected through the separate text/icon content token before any resource change. Remaining non-selected nine-slice surfaces retain their owned deterministic source path.
